other.title: Apple Store in UK Permanently Closing Today
other.description: Apple Festival Place in Basingstoke, England will be permanently closing today, following more than 15 years of business. Apple said all employees at the Festival Place store would have the opportunity to work at Apple The Oracle in nearby Reading or at other Apple Store locations in the country. Apple is opening an upgraded, modernized store at The Oracle in December.
